description: Airbnb stays for a place and dates (first results page, usually 18): listing id, name, type, total price for the stay in the chosen currency (and original price when discounted), rating out of 5 with review count, beds/bathrooms, badges such as Guest favourite, free-cancellation note, coordinates and room URL. From Airbnb's public search page; availability and prices as Airbnb shows them at call time. Related tools on this server, for a different need: travel_agoda when you need top hotels in a city from Agoda's city guide page: about 10; travel_hostelworld when you need Hostels in a city as listed on Hostelworld's public city. Price: $0.002 per successful call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana and 10 more networks); failed calls are not charged.

checkin.description: Check-in date YYYY-MM-DD (optional; Airbnb picks flexible dates without it)
